notes: Consolidated reference (keys site.r_code and metric; 'metric' is not a fact, so rules do not look this file up). Operative lookup: table-4B-avg. C4.1.3 to C4.1.5 refer to 'the minimum and average site area of Table 4B' although the table has no minimum column. Transcribed from Chapter 4 Part 1 p51; values identical to current Table D multiple dwelling averages (C4P1-147). Average only: no minimum site area applies to apartments, and the dwelling-type column is removed. Unlike Chapter 3 Table 3B, the R10-R25 averages are not struck through: the maisonette / low-scale apartment reform is consultation only (Information Sheet 5), so they stay operative (C4P1-149). Values differ from Chapter 3 at R40 (115 v 220), R50 (100 v 180) and R60 (85 v 150). Explanatory Guidelines: yield = lot area / average site area, rounded down; residential component of mixed use only.

verified.note: No minimum column on p51 although C4.1.3-C4.1.6 refer to the minimum site area of Table 4B; averages not struck through.
